SELECT c.id, c.title, c.subtitle, c.cover, c.type, CASE c.type WHEN 0 THEN '视频课' WHEN 1 THEN '书本课' ELSE '未知' END AS type_text, c.difficulty, CASE c.difficulty WHEN 1 THEN '入门' WHEN 2 THEN '进阶' WHEN 3 THEN '高级' ELSE '未知' END AS difficulty_text, c.tags, c.chapter_count, c.view_count, c.is_apod_course, c.is_mars_course,
CASE WHEN cf.id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_favorite, cp.last_chapter_id,
NULL AS is_favorite, NULL AS last_chapter_id,
ROUND((SELECT AVG(r.rating) FROM tb_course_review r WHERE r.course_id = c.id AND r.status = 1), 1) AS avg_rating, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_course_review r WHERE r.course_id = c.id AND r.status = 1) AS review_count FROM tb_course c
LEFT JOIN tb_course_favorite cf ON cf.course_id = c.id AND cf.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN tb_course_progress cp ON cp.course_id = c.id AND cp.user_id = #{userId}
c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1
AND c.type = #{dto.type}
AND c.difficulty = #{dto.difficulty}
AND c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.keyword}, '%')
AND JSON_CONTAINS(c.tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{tag}))
ORDER BY c.sort DESC, c.create_time DESC

SELECT DISTINCT p.tags FROM tb_order o INNER JOIN tb_order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id INNER JOIN tb_product p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.status != 4 AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.create_time >= #{since} AND p.tags IS NOT NULL AND p.tags != '' AND p.deleted = 0

SELECT c.id, c.title, c.subtitle, c.cover, c.type, CASE c.type WHEN 0 THEN '视频课' WHEN 1 THEN '书本课' ELSE '未知' END AS type_text, c.difficulty, CASE c.difficulty WHEN 1 THEN '入门' WHEN 2 THEN '进阶' WHEN 3 THEN '高级' ELSE '未知' END AS difficulty_text, c.tags, c.chapter_count, c.view_count, c.is_apod_course, c.is_mars_course, CASE WHEN cf.id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_favorite, NULL AS last_chapter_id, ROUND((SELECT AVG(r.rating) FROM tb_course_review r WHERE r.course_id = c.id AND r.status = 1), 1) AS avg_rating, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_course_review r WHERE r.course_id = c.id AND r.status = 1) AS review_count FROM tb_course c LEFT JOIN tb_course_favorite cf ON cf.course_id = c.id AND cf.user_id = #{userId} WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
